gaps.sentence: I would tell you if I ___, but it is a secret.
gaps.explanation: An unreal present condition takes the past simple after 'if': knew.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ you at the airport last week, but I was abroad.
gaps.hint: regret about a missed past meeting
gaps.explanation: Regret about something that did not happen takes 'wish' plus the past perfect: had met.

gaps.sentence: I wish you ___ so pessimistic about the project.
gaps.hint: a wish about a present attitude
gaps.explanation: Wishes about present states use 'were': were not.

gaps.sentence: Ice ___ if you leave it in the sun.
gaps.explanation: In zero conditionals both clauses use the present simple: melts.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ to your advice — then I would not be in this mess.
gaps.hint: regret about the past, past perfect
gaps.explanation: 'Wish' plus the past perfect expresses regret about the past: had listened.

gaps.sentence: Provided that the weather ___ dry, the festival will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'Provided that' introduces the condition and takes the present simple: stays.

gaps.sentence: If only we ___ the tickets before they sold out!
gaps.explanation: 'If only' plus the past perfect regrets a missed past opportunity: had bought.

gaps.sentence: They would have won the match if their best player ___ injured.
gaps.hint: unreal past needs the past perfect
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition requires the past perfect: had not been.
